hints.title: Fixed Turn Rate Mapping
hints.text: Notice that the sword rate on the j-th broken lock is exactly j + 1 for each step from 0 to n - 1.

hints.title: Bipartite Cost Matrix
hints.text: Construct an n by n cost matrix where cost[i][j] is the minutes needed to break lock i when rate is j + 1.

hints.title: Optimal Assignment
hints.text: Find a perfect matching between locks and steps that minimizes total cost using Hungarian algorithm.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Hungarian algorithm solves minimum-weight bipartite matching between locks and sequential turn indices.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Exponential subset search is intractable for n up to 80.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n^2) cost matrix tracking time to break lock i on step j.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Formulates the assignment as minimum-weight bipartite matching using Hungarian algorithm or min-cost flow.
